decisions.rationale: The complete occupational term directly attests performer. Do not split a speculative perform or person member from the single English word.
The second ZLOS GAR denotes the performed show, distinct from the first occurrence embedded in performer. The complete expression directly attests show.

The complete doing/performing verb is rendered by the English phrasal verb put on. BYED PA attests put and perform, not a literal full put on glossary phrase; this contextual realization performs the show rather than putting an object on a surface.

Keep the complete temporal/occasion construction with at in at a show. GNAS SKABS time/occasion and whole GNAS SKABS SU during a period support this local grammatical reduction; its mined cases gloss does not justify assigning the initial general cases frame here.
GZHAN denotes the other people entertained. Complete other/another reference material supports the plural others; the unrelated mined a bodhisattva gloss is not used.

MGU BA has satisfaction/delight HGM and please/make happy/gladden reference material, without literal entertain. Telling narrative accounts for others pleasure supports this contextual entertain verb provisionally.
The explicit purpose marker supplies to introducing the aim of entertaining others. Its local scope is distinct from the later relative/authorship grammar.

Keep the complete narrative compound with stories. Its HGM is accounts and Sanskrit comparanda include narrative/tale terms; the current telling-to-entertain clause supports stories without claiming an exact stories HGM gloss.

The complete speech verb supplies contextual past told. The full master has speak/say/talking and uttering reference senses, not a literal told HGM entry; source tense is realized by the English narrative.
DANG connects the two further examples and is rendered by the full alternative coordinator or too. Where is the repeated example frame, not another part of this coordinator.
The complete group noun directly attests non-buddhist. Keep its capital source realization and whole BA form; neither non nor Buddhist is assigned to a speculative source member.
The complete BSTAN BCOS directly attests commentary. Written by expands the following authorship relationship; it is not a separate source writing verb.
NGAN PA directly attests wrong and qualifies the commentary. It is not confused with the separate LOG PA wrong in the next definition.
The recitation verb directly attests reciting. Began is left outside: attachment/desire CHAGS is not silently equated with began merely because the English aspect is explicit.
